name: Menards Receipt
description: This receipt represents a point-of-sale transaction from MENARDS – RACINE, located at 3101 South Oakes Road, Sturtevant, WI 53177. The receipt header features the MENARDS® logo followed by full store identification details and return policy messaging. A barcode appears above the “Sale Transaction” section. The receipt includes SKU reference formatting and quantity structure, followed by a financial summary listing TOTAL, TAX RACINE-WI 5.1%, and TOTAL SALE. The payment section reflects AMERICAN EXPRESS processing, including authorization code, chip insertion confirmation, application identifier (AID), and transaction certificate reference. The document records total number of items and includes a “GUEST COPY” designation, cardholder acknowledgment statement, credit card sales slip notice, and cashier acknowledgment line. The format reflects a home improvement retail POS receipt with integrated policy notice, barcode encoding, and full card-processing metadata.
